changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwvaccine AS SELECT v.id, v.name, v.atc_code, v.type, v.roa, v.site_of_administration, v.post_opening_duration, v.duration_unit, v.number_of_doses, v.indications, v.possible_reactions, v.contraindications_and_precautions, v.storage_and_handling, v.facility_id, v.price, v.is_active, v.created_by, v.created_date, v.last_modified_by, v.last_modified_date FROM public.vaccine v;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwvaccine TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwvaccine FROM report_user;
